content: Yusufe hodi okkolor šoppon bangi der
Iyar bade zai, Mišoror razar šoraf baṛidoya okkolor maziye edde ruṭibanoya okkolor maziye hitarar malik, Mišoror razar berudde hosuri goijje.
Feruwan šoraf baṛidoya okkolor mazi edde ruṭibanoya okkolor mazi, ei dui hormosarir uwore gušša oiye,
edde hitarare faharadar okkolor boror górot, zeṛe Yusufore bondi gori raka oiye, heṛe bondi gori rakkiye.
Faharadar okkolor boroye hitarare Yusufor hatot diye, ar Yusufe hitarar kermos goijje. Hitara bout din heṛe bondi taki bade,
Razar šoraf baṛidoya edde ruṭibanoya ze duizonore ziyolot raikke, hitara dunizone ekkui raitta ekzone ekkan ekkan šoppon deikke, ar hitarar ek ekkan šopponor ek ekkan mani aššil.
Tarfordin binna Yusuf hitarar hãse aiyore dekedde, ar so, hitarar nak muk beši andar.
Toi Yusufor fũwati Feruwanor ze dui hormosari hibar fũwati hibar munifor górot ziyolot bondi aššil, hitarare hibaye fusar goredde, "Õnorare saite aijja nak muk eto andar kiyolla lager?"
Hitara zuwab diye, "Ãra dunizone šoppon dekki, kintu hinor mani buzai dibolla hono kiye nai" Yusufe hitara dunizonore hodde, "Mani buzai dibar šokti Allattu no o ne? meherbani gori šoppongun ãre ho."
Toi oi mazi šoraf baṛidoyaye Yusufore hitar soppongan funaiye, hite hibare hodde, "Ãr šopponot dekidde, so, ãr muntu ekkan ãngur lota,
ar hiyanot tinnwa ḍeila aššil. Ar hinot holi ai mottor ful fuiṭṭe edde hinot tũka tũka oiyore fona ãngur oiye.
Ar Feruwanor fiyalawa ãr hatot aššil edde ãi he ãngurgun loiyi, hinore Feruwanor fiyalat roš sibi loi fiyalawa Feruwanor hatot dilam."
Yusufe hitare hodde: "Iyanor mani oilde endilla, tinnuwa ḍeila oilde tin din.
Tin dinor butore Feruwane õnore šormane entu eri dibo edde õnor agor hamot õnore uwafes dibo, ar õne age zendilla hibar šoraf baṛidoya aššila, hendilla tũi Feruwanor hatot fiyala tuli diba.
Kintu zẽtte õnor balai oibo, foriyad gorir õne ãre monot raikko edde ãr uwore doya dehaiyo; ãr babute Feruwanore hoiba edde õne ãre ei górottu niyolaiba.
Kiyollahoile ãre Ibroni okkolor dešottu sur gori ana oiye, ar eṛe o ãi en hono kissu no gori ze hitarattu ãre gãtot raka fore."
Ruṭibanoya okkolor maziye zehon dekilo ze Yusufe šopponor bala mani hoiye, toi hite Yusufore hodde, "Ãi o ekkan šoppon dekkilam: So, ãr matar uwore tin ṭuri fiṛa ase.
Uoror ṭurit Feruwanolla banaiya hãr ḍoilla hana, ar faik okkole ãr matar uwore ṭurittu hinore hát roiye."
Yusufe hodde, "Iyanor mani oilde endilla, tinnuwa ṭuri oilde tinnwa din.
Tin dinor butore Feruwane õnor holla loibo edde gagan gasot zulai rakibo, ar faik okkole gusto háibo."
Bade tin dinor din Feruwan zormo dinot, hite hitar hormosari okkololla ek mela goijje. Hite he mazi šoraf baṛidoya edde mazi ruṭibanoyare hormosari okkolor sarme hazir goijje:
Hite mazi šoraf baṛidoyaware hitar agor hamot uwafes diye, toi hite abar Feruwanor hatot fiyala tulidiya šuru goijje.
Kintu he mazi ruṭibanoyare faši diye, zendilla Yusufe hitarare mani bangidil.
He mazi šoraf baṛidoyawaye tarfore o Yusufore monot no rake, hibare foraifelail.
